- cJSON 1.7.18, MIT; see `cjson/LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/archive/refs/tags/v1.7.18.tar.gz. Archive SHA-256: `3aa806844a03442c00769b83e99970be70fbef03735ff898f4811dd03b9f5ee5`.

Only upstream source and license files are vendored. Local changes should be avoided; update the pinned versions and hashes together.
